time_to_close.description: Records the completion of a real estate transaction closing event with the action type and category captured for measurement.

property_listing_views.description: Records when a user views a property listing, including the listing identifier, location, and property type classification.

property_view_count.description: Records the number of times a property listing has been viewed, incremented with each view occurrence.

user_demographics.description: Records user demographic attributes including age range, gender, and interests for audience segmentation and analysis.

view_item.description: Records when a user views a real estate listing item with the listing verification status indicating the property review state.

add_payment_info.description: Records when a user provides financing or payment information, capturing the financing method and transaction identifier.

generate_lead.description: Records when a real estate lead is generated, with the lead_urgency parameter indicating the priority level of the inquiry.

Property Inquiry Submission.description: Records when a user submits an inquiry about a property, capturing the submission action and inquiry category.

search.description: Records when a user performs a property search with comprehensive filter parameters including location, price range, property specifications, amenities, and result pagination.

form_start.description: Records when a user begins a mortgage pre-approval or real estate application form, capturing form metadata, user context, device information, and application attempt state.
